objects.description: During the [2026 U.S. Water Utilities Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0066), the adversary located internet-exposed PLCs (e.g., Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley MicroLogix 1100 and 1400 PLCs, etc.) at water and wastewater utilities, including cellular-connected water towers and sewer lift stations, and logged in to them directly.(Citation: Tenable Minnesota Water Utilities)(Citation: Forescout Water Systems Attack)(Citation: FBI Water and Wastewater)
